observation: Docker changes eth0/eth1 naming across fresh container starts. The registered condition selects the interface carrying the outgoing default route on every start, rather than a fixed literal name. study.listen_interface records the paused preflight observation.
evidence: Archived profile/bench/deluge-ipv6-init.sh reads /proc/net/route, requires exactly one default gateway interface, and writes that interface into the preference before daemon startup.
